narrative: Material PL3__MF2AB007 shows moderate demand with left_skewed distribution (CV=60.87%). Lead time is volatile (CV=89.22%), dominated by leadtime variability (69%). Current SAP safety stock of 81,555 units is significantly oversized. Recommended optimization reduces safety stock to 2,573 units while maintaining 95% service level, yielding annual savings of $13,713.18 (81.1%). The optimized policy uses EOQ-based ordering with MOQ constraint (22,835 units), reorder point of 4,032 units, and review period of ~16 days. Safety lead time should be increased from 0.0 to 2.4 days to account for lead time volatility.
